basic_info.description: No expense was spared in the construction of this stunning home, a pinnacle of modern architecture, rebuilt from the ground up. The residence was curated with bespoke finishes and the finest materials imported from Europe. Set on an extra wide lot and a sought-after block of Pacific Heights, the home boasts sweeping views of the Golden Gate and the SF Bay. Fully detached on three sides, with crisp lines and generous proportions, the airy interior of the house is a veritable work of art, flooded in natural light and highlighted by a stunning glass-framed floating staircase. The showcase kitchen, featuring a dramatic accent wall, two islands, and floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, opens to an expansive south-facing yard with outdoor kitchen. The entertainment level includes a media room, gym and pool table room with a sliding glass wall that opens to an idyllic stone waterfall feature. The exquisite primary suite enjoys sweeping views, an ultra-luxe spa-like bath, and dual walk-in closets. Two additional bedrooms and laundry complete this level while a sliding skylight provides access to a potential roofdeck. Amenities include: elevator, A/C, radiant heat, complete smart home control, pet shower, car wash, and security system. This architectural masterpiece is not to be missed.
